prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: rough manga name/storyboard source contact sheet, not finished art.
Make a LANDSCAPE 1536x1024 contact sheet with exactly EIGHT independent portrait drawings in a strict regular grid: FOUR equal columns, TWO equal rows. Each cell is about 3:4 portrait. Thin straight grid separators, a little white margin between cells. The numbered descriptions below refer to positions but DO NOT print numbers or text. Top row RIGHT to LEFT shows the first four beats; bottom row RIGHT to LEFT shows the next four beats. Every cell shows only its specified single moment, no inset subpanels, no repeated filler drawings.
Input image is ONLY for identity: same short light bob healer Mina in a white plain work coat, same short dark hair soldier Ren in a dark plain tunic. Ignore the reference's polished graphite shading and four-cell layout.
Style: VERY ROUGH 15-second manga thumbnail / name pencil drawings. Clear simple human faces, expressive brows and mouth, readable body gesture and hand action. Loose economical pencil lines on white paper. No finished rendering, no crosshatching, no textures, no tonal shading, no color. Real sketched people, not stick figures. Spare background props only. Large simple heads and hands rather than tiny detailed figures.
Continuity: current tent scenes use Ren on LEFT facing right and Mina on RIGHT facing left. Ren injured RIGHT forearm, healthy LEFT hand. Same canvas treatment tent, low table, basin, canvas ropes and wooden pole. Only specified characters and action in each cell. Injury is a small non-graphic cut, not gore. Do not add weapons or armor.
Leave clear white space along the upper side of each cell for later HTML vertical speech lettering, while preserving large readable faces and hands around the middle/lower part. No text, letters, numerals, captions, balloons, speech tails or written sound effects anywhere. All exact Japanese dialogue and sounds will be added in HTML afterward.
Eight positions:
TOP RIGHT (p01): Wide dusk exterior of a canvas treatment tent. Mina in a white work coat stands on the right beneath the awning, an empty path receding on the left, heavy rain clouds gathering beyond. Visible acting: ミナは帰路を見張りながら平静な仕事の姿勢を保とうとする。. Only this moment.
TOP SECOND FROM RIGHT (p02): Medium view of Mina on the right checking a small lantern and the darkening sky, her light bob hair lifted by damp wind, the empty path still visible over her shoulder. Visible acting: 心配を天候の確認へ置き換え、声を冷静な報告にする。. Only this moment.
TOP SECOND FROM LEFT (p03): Close view of Mina facing left toward the path. She holds a folded dry cloth against her chest with one tense hand while her expression stays professionally blank. Visible acting: 遅れへの不安を責める形に変えて隠す。. Only this moment.
TOP LEFT (p04): Long shot from inside the awning: Ren enters from the left along the wet path, short dark hair plastered by rain, dark soldier clothing, his right forearm guarded against his body. Visible acting: レンは帰ってきた姿を見せればミナを安心させられると思い、痛みを隠す。. Only this moment.
BOTTOM RIGHT (p05): Two-shot under the awning. Mina on the right straightens with a controlled face; Ren on the left stops just outside the dry area and avoids showing his arm. Visible acting: ミナは喜びを丁寧語に押し込め、レンはその硬さを心配の裏返しとまだ読まない。. Only this moment.
BOTTOM SECOND FROM RIGHT (p06): Medium two-shot. Ren gives a small formal bow on the left while keeping his injured right forearm behind his coat; Mina watches the hidden shoulder rather than his face. Visible acting: 帰還の報告を済ませ、すぐ腕を隠して話を終わらせたい。. Only this moment.
BOTTOM SECOND FROM LEFT (p07): Low close-up on the damp floor between them. A red drop falls from the edge of Ren's right sleeve onto the wood while both pairs of boots are visible at opposite sides. Visible acting: レンは音に気づき、隠す努力が破れたことを悟る。. Only this moment.
BOTTOM LEFT (p08): Tight two-shot at the awning edge. Mina on the right extends a basin with both hands; Ren on the left keeps his right arm tucked back, his mouth set in a practiced calm. Visible acting: ミナは選択肢を渡すように言いながら、実際には手当てを始めたい。レンは心配を増やさないため拒む。. Only this moment.
Do not include dialogue in the source. Prioritize the distinct actions and emotions, strict eight-cell layout, and very rough line-only thumbnail style.

TOP SECOND FROM RIGHT (p10): Ren on the left turns his body three-quarters away and lifts his uninjured hand as if dismissing the matter; the wrapped right forearm disappears behind his dark coat. Visible acting: 大事にしたくないという意図で説明を短く切る。. Only this moment.

TOP LEFT (p12): Detail of Ren's wet sleeve and trembling fingers. Mud, river grass, and a fresh cut show that the injury happened outdoors, not during an ordinary patrol. Visible acting: レンは川での出来事を思い出し、ミナへ説明すべきだと迷う。. Only this moment.
BOTTOM RIGHT (p13): Flashback wide view of a swollen river under rain. Ren reaches from a rocky bank on the left while only a small boy's sleeve and hand break the water surface; the boy's face is not shown. Visible acting: レンは自分が濡れることより、目の前の小さな手を取ることを優先した。. Only this moment.
BOTTOM SECOND FROM RIGHT (p14): Flashback medium close-up. Ren's left hand grips the boy's sleeve above the current while broken river debris cuts across Ren's right forearm; his face is strained but focused. Visible acting: 恐怖を見せる暇なく、相手に生きる動作を命じる。. Only this moment.
BOTTOM SECOND FROM LEFT (p15): Flashback from the riverbank. Ren pulls the boy toward shore with his left arm and passes him toward an off-screen villager whose dark-sleeved hands enter from the right; only the boy’s wet sleeve is visible, with no other named character in frame. Visible acting: レンは自分が戻ることより先に、少年が安全な手へ渡るまでをやり切る。. Only this moment.
BOTTOM LEFT (p16): Back inside the tent. Ren lowers his eyes on the left; Mina on the right holds the clean cloth but has softened her stare, the river memory now sitting between them. Visible acting: レンは言い訳ではなく事実だけを返し、ミナは責める言葉を選ばない。. Only this moment.

TOP SECOND FROM RIGHT (p18): Ren sits on the left and slowly extends his right forearm across the small table. He looks toward Mina but keeps his jaw tight, waiting for her judgment. Visible acting: レンは傷よりも、待たせたミナの気持ちを確かめたい。. Only this moment.

TOP LEFT (p20): Close view of Mina's cloth touching the edge of Ren's wound. Ren's fingers curl against the table and his shoulders jerk once, while Mina's hand stops before pressing further. Visible acting: レンは平気を言う前に反射的に痛がる。ミナは責めずに観察する。. Only this moment.
BOTTOM RIGHT (p21): Two-shot close. Mina on the right keeps the cloth poised over the wound; Ren on the left looks away, trying to recover his composed face. Visible acting: ミナは正直な反応を引き出したい。レンは答えを小さくすれば治療を続けられると思う。. Only this moment.
BOTTOM SECOND FROM RIGHT (p22): Ren answers from the left with a controlled mouth, but his knuckles whiten around the table edge and his right forearm stays rigid under Mina's cloth. Visible acting: レンはミナを安心させたいが、痛みを無かったことにもしたい。. Only this moment.
BOTTOM SECOND FROM LEFT (p23): Mina looks from Ren's clenched hand to his face. Her posture remains formal, but her thumb loosens the pressure of the cloth with deliberate care. Visible acting: 冷たい言葉で、正直になっても見捨てないと伝える。. Only this moment.
